rows.grounds: locative plural of numeral as given

items.question: By what measure of count and location are certain beings said to endure torment in this enumeration?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the set in question.
That count is placed within thousands as a locative measure.
The location is specified as womb-diagrams where torment occurs.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings tormented is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
